reviews.title: Free trial not free
reviews.text: I had app on phone for like a day? Said there was a free trial. Dont do it!

reviews.title: This app is a joke
reviews.text: This app is shockingly bad. It routinely gets calories wrong even when you scan the barcode! Get one that works. Not this one.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: Freezes constantly

reviews.title: Disappointed and frustrated
reviews.text: Paid for the upgrade and have had issues since. Keeps freezing, customer support don’t response so non existent. I would not recommend save your money and use my fitness pal

reviews.title: Crash APP
reviews.text: This app is totally worthless. You take a picture of the food it tells you it’s something completely different. You take a picture of the barcode and it’s a different food. Every time I add a food from past history, you have to reset the app. Too many bugs.. and the support is worthless . They don’t even reply .

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: The database is absolutley terrible. I bought for a year based on reviews and the most common things I eat are never in the database. The ai scan isn’t accurate. You have to choose the closest thing which is not helpful when watching calories. If ur going to try use the trial first to see if u like it first. The reviews are good for this app but I don’t see how when the database is very limited.

reviews.title: Can’t change serving size!!!
reviews.text: It does not let you change serving size. Otherwise I would give it 5 stars. I wish I could get my money back. What a waste of money.

reviews.title: The worse APP
reviews.text: Do not purchase! It glitches. Does not offer any free trials. Charges your credit card without having ask if you want the monthly or annual. I emailed the team and their response was we don’t have an email on file are you sure you’re contacting the right department?  Don’t buy this App. Lose It App is so much better

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I haven’t used it yet. I can’t rate it.

reviews.title: Cannot alter serving size
reviews.text: It is impossible to edit serving size. The edit function shows a “.” So theoretically you should be able to edit to .25 serving for example - but that function does not work. Makes whole app useless.

reviews.title: Mucho dinero
reviews.text: Veinte dólares por un mes de su subscription cuando en la otra pagas 20 d dólares si lo agarras en promoción por todo el año

reviews.title: Really inaccurate weight app
reviews.text: This app is really inaccurate. If you take a picture of your food, it doesn’t include all of the food in the picture. If you manually enter your food items, the lists are really limited so you can’t see even get a good calorie count that way either. If you want to use a recipe, they don’t accurately list the measurements (what does “serving “ mean from r each ingredient?) for each ingredient so you’re stuck there too. An all around useless app. 😩

reviews.title: Not good, avoid.
reviews.text:
The UI is polished but the results are really inaccurate and I found several issues with barcode scanning in general.

Edit: I wanted to give it another try but it still has a lot of the same issues it had when I initially tried it. Found a similar free product with better results.

reviews.title: Inaccurate estimations!
reviews.text: I’m deeply disappointed with this app. No sooner than I went ahead and paid for my subscription, the app is giving ridiculously low inaccurate estimates of carbs , calories, sugar and fat! I snap a picture of my plate of scrambled eggs, hash browns, breakfast sausages and w bowl of oatmeal and it will say there are only four grams of carbs in total! The bowl of oatmeal has at least 27 grams of carbs alone. I’m so sorry I paid for this thing! I’m a T2D and I need accuracy or a realistic estimation of carbs and other things. Now I’m hunting for an app that’s more accurate. Wasted money!

reviews.title: Shuts down
reviews.text: Everyday when I log my items this app shuts down after every log. It is frustrating to use. Especially when you pay for it.

reviews.title: Joke!
reviews.text:
After 24 hours the scan picture won’t pick up items and says 0 calories for beer, food etc-

Absolutely a joke!!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
Not accurate at all, can’t change the servings from 1 serving to half or less.  
The scanner isn’t right!!
What a waste of money!!

reviews.title: Stopped allowing me to search for food items
reviews.text: This app worked well for the first few days, albeit be with the inaccuracy of calorie estimations others have identified. Then, each time I tried to add a food item and used the search feature, I got a pop-up asking me to sign up for the $36.99 yearly plan, which I had already purchased. I was able to enter water and any item I had used in the past, but not any new foods. I did go to the App Store and update the app as had been suggested in a prior review, with no improvement. I have submitted a Help request but received no response.

reviews.title: App is NOT accurate
reviews.text:
Literally just subscribed to this app and I demand a refund of £15.99 !!!  I have already cancelled my subscription. 
It is NOT accurate 
It does not recognise most of the items I’ve scanned today already. 
It said a 225g of garlic bread only had 161 kcal in it!!!….actual is approximately 600kcal! 
Very disappointed! 
And no setting on the app to stop adverts or for any customer service support!
Please give me my money back immediately!

reviews.title: Latency Issues
reviews.text: I have used the app for over 3 months and recently there has been a very annoying lag time when uploading my food data for each meal.    They need to address the issue and fix it

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This app is not what it says it is. Incorrect information on a lot of the products you scan without being able to amend them. Making it no quicker than other apps - do not recommend

reviews.title: Double counts calories burned
reviews.text: Pulls exercise from Apple Health. Steps, walking, elliptical are all added to your total steps. Gives false reading for how many calories you can take in because exercise is double counted.

reviews.title: Charged me twice
reviews.text: I was charged twice and when I tried to contact SnapCal none of their emails worked.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: The ai scanner is not consistent when scanning and measuring food. Information when bar code scanned is not consistent and when you want to edit to add the correct information it will not let you do it. Frustration is what you get for $38.99

reviews.title: Avoid this scam!
reviews.text: Avoid! Scam! I fell for the hype but it doesn't accurately assess what you photograph. My first upload was a large salad including avocado and pine nuts. It gave me a C+, said that it was classic comfort and next time I should add a side salad and a handful of nuts!! Unfortunately, against my better judgement, I bought a year subscription before my upload. I WANT MY MONEY BACK.

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: This app is complete trash. I switched my phone and couldn’t log in my account, also the calories are way off. It gives you wrong information

reviews.title: Refund required
reviews.text:
Update 13 April 2026: even after their response telling me to go to settings to log my issue, I then get directed to their website, find the email address to contact … NO RESPONSE. 

Update 15 March 2026: IF YOU ARE IN THE UK DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. NOT A SINGLE BARCODE WORKS. I’m requesting a refund but there is no response.  

My original message: I’d like a refund. Every single barcode I scan does NOT work. Nothing is in the database. Not even common foods from everyday brands.

reviews.title: Stopped accurately recording food
reviews.text: I have been using this app for several months with no issues.  However, several days ago, while scanning QR codes, the calorie count was 8-10 times higher than it should be.  I turned my phone off hoping this would “reset” things but it continues to be incorrect.  I do not want to manually input all my food correctly.  I have contacted the company with no response.  I would like my money refunded so I can try another app.

reviews.title: Sneaky! Charged in 48 hours
reviews.text: Sadly, no way to track water or supplements.  And charged high fee way before trial was over.

reviews.title: Bar code scanning ruined
reviews.text: Recent update has broken the ability to scan barcodes and get data per serving. Please fix it; currently it pulls data for the whole bag or box of the product, not per serving.  Regretting purchase at this app at this point.

reviews.title: Not Great
reviews.text:
Use MyFitnessPal and you’ll be happier.  Bigger library of foods, can also scan barcodes.  The AI portion of this app is so inconsistent. Scan same dish 3 times, get 3 different results. 
It’s a good try, but just not there yet.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
At first, this app looked promising. However, it was full of bugs and half of it stopped working after 2 days even though I still had an active subscription. 

It did not track workout data even though Health+ was connected and all options were enabled. 

After two days, the top widget that specifies the remaining calories went completely empty.

Taking a picture of a nutrition label was never accurate. 

Lastly, there is no account creation so you lose data if you delete the app or download on a different device.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work, premium ads are extremely bothersome
reviews.text: Tried to log a meal by using the ai scanner. Didn’t work. I suppose it’s only for the paid account. Tried to scan the barcode. Didn’t work. Not to mention after EVERY user interaction, an ad pops up to subscribe to the premium account. Horrible user experience and is more annoying to use it. I’d rather use any other app because the whole purpose is to make logging food quick, but with all the pop ups and having to manually enter every entry,  it takes twice as long to log food than a different app or just using pen and paper. the app just isn’t worth the trouble. ALSO- their recipes look yummy but don’t write how much 1 serving is equal to… 100g? 20g? It doesn’t say so the calorie and macro counts don’t have any value if you don’t know the serving size

reviews.title: Change the grams and more
reviews.text: How do we change the calories on some products? I scanned a bar code and the product came up 5000g of protein.  When it’s actually 50

reviews.title: It costs money…
reviews.text: I HATE the apps that say “FREE!!!” But then once you go through all the steps… “oh but it costs monthly!!!” Such a waste of time.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: You have to pay to use this app!  It’s not worth it.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: None of the bar code scans work - the images are hopeless at recognising food and quantities - how do I get my money back?

reviews.title: Poor Scanning
reviews.text:
The scanner doesn’t scan the product codes and says it’s yet to update, poor really, MyFitness Pal is what I’m currently using and logs nearly 99% of all goods, 
should give me my money back, useless

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: Does not scan food or allows you to input manually - I tried several foods in different locations to avoid glare and none worked.

reviews.title: Do not buy!! Not worth your money!
reviews.text: Does not work half the time.

reviews.title: Camera option
reviews.text: The calories are extremely inconsistent. A picture of the same meal varies by 300 cal. Also, the camera function stopped working midway through the week.

reviews.title: Does not work as advertised
reviews.text: This app does not even recognize a sunny side up fried egg.

reviews.title: No good
reviews.text: I too am very disappointed. Don’t buy.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: I was interested in finding an app to assist in my journey to be a healthy eater but this is of no use.  I didn’t read the reviews and signed up for the app.   After I downloaded it, I tested it with 5 pre made meals that I do know the macros and micros and this app wasn’t even close to reality.  After reading the reviews, it appears they are impossible to contact and as expected, very little chance of getting a refund.

reviews.title: Does NOT feed AppleHealth
reviews.text: Seems logical that tracking app would be able to connect to AppleHealth to track food intake.

reviews.title: Entering Calories
reviews.text: You cannot enter less then a full serving of something. If calories are clearly wrong on a scan you cannot change them. It’s hard to enter items if they don’t scan or scan in improperly which is 95% of the time

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: I never review anything but this app has compelled me.  I wanted to try it but the app can not tell the precise amount of of food on the plate nor can it know what is exactly in the food so there is no way to give an accurate calorie count.  In addition, it gets food wrong.  Doesn’t recognize many foods.  It’s honestly a waste of money and life written to complain but no one has gotten back.  This apparently was created by an 18 year old and it shows.  Stay away from this one.

reviews.title: Bars can hopeless
reviews.text: Has not yet identified a barcode , which other cal counter can with no problem . Failed on foods as well . Not impressed .

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Downloaded app this morning tried scanning products don’t recognise any barcodes or products, enter products in and it doesn’t bring up right calories on app to what says on product. So wasted £29.99 for a years use 😡

reviews.title: Too time consuming
reviews.text:
There’s no way to save a “favorite” so you have to re-enter your (e.g yogurt, banana) every time. The recent foods tabs only logs approx 7-10 things. EDIT don’t bother reaching out for help you’ll never hear back. It’s a huge time suck.
Another update. Finally got a response from support OMG BOT generated response that answered nothing and provided zero help.

reviews.title: Weight Loss
reviews.text: Let’s loose some weight.

reviews.title: Not Usable
reviews.text:
This app is hard to use. Unable to input portions of weight or servings. For example it isn’t possible to enter 1 & 1/2 cups of a food. Only choice is 1 or 2.
Also most foods are listed as a “serving “. Does everyone know what a serving of every food is??

reviews.title: Cannot track less than 1 serving. Exercise log cannot be altered and tracks double.
reviews.text: Not happy at all. Will be contacting Apple for a refund. The app is useless for the reasons I stated above. Sent feedback via app. No response. .

reviews.title: Reliability
reviews.text: After a month of use the app quit working entirely

reviews.title: Useless.
reviews.text: This ap worked good for less than a week. Now it won’t even open at all. It flashes when I try to open it then does nothing. Won’t even bring up a screen so I can’t even cancel the subscription. Deleted and reinstalled. Lost all my data. Worked for one day then says network error and won’t pick up anything. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Junk
reviews.text: I cannot cancel this. It’s junk. It doesn’t do those wonderful things that it shows it’s doing, it’s no better than a simple calorie counter – they’re free all over the place. I’m trying to get a refund. There’s absolutely no response. I think those five star ratings are a hoax

reviews.title: Difficult
reviews.text: This app won’t let me enter my amounts.  For instance if I type a food in and it says 1 oz but classifies it as a serving.  What is a serving?  And once I change anything such as weight it won’t let me log it.  The app is too difficult to use
